\(\{p_\sigma\}_{\sigma \in \Sigma}\)  \(\sigma\)
\[D_{KL}(p_{\sigma} \parallel p_{\sigma+d\sigma}) = \frac{1}{2} g_{\mu\nu}(\sigma) \, d\sigma^\mu d\sigma^\nu + o(\|d\sigma\|^2)\]
\(g_{\mu\nu}(\sigma) = \mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\partial \log p}{\partial \sigma^\mu} \frac{\partial \log p}{\partial \sigma^\nu}\right]\)  Fisher

**** \(\log \frac{p_\sigma}{p_{\sigma+d\sigma}} = \log p_\sigma - \log p_{\sigma+d\sigma}\)  \(d\sigma\)
\[\log p_{\sigma+d\sigma} = \log p_\sigma + \partial_\mu \log p_\sigma \, d\sigma^\mu + \frac{1}{2} \partial_\mu \partial_\nu \log p_\sigma \, d\sigma^\mu d\sigma^\nu + o(\|d\sigma\|^2)\]

\[D_{KL} = \mathbb{E}\left[\partial_\mu \log p_\sigma \, d\sigma^\mu + \frac{1}{2} \partial_\mu \partial_\nu \log p_\sigma \, d\sigma^\mu d\sigma^\nu\right]\]
\(\mathbb{E}[\partial_\mu \log p_\sigma] = 0\)
\(\mathbb{E}[\partial_\mu \partial_\nu \log p] = -\mathbb{E}[\partial_\mu \log p \cdot \partial_\nu \log p] = -g_{\mu\nu}\)
\(D_{KL} = \frac{1}{2} g_{\mu\nu} d\sigma^\mu d\sigma^\nu + o(\|d\sigma\|^2)\)
